BehaviorSettings.description: Runtime guidance the coordinator adds to an agent's context while it works.

CommandNotificationSettings.description: Tell an agent when a background shell command it started finishes.

wake_idle.description: Start a turn for an idle agent when one of its background commands finishes.

DirectoryInstructionSettings.description: Add AGENTS.md files from directories the agent reads or edits.

max_bytes.description: Bytes of one instruction file added to context; longer files are truncated.

route_tools.description: Tool IDs or discovery catalog IDs advertised through eval when it is allowed.

LoopGuardSettings.description: Detect an agent repeating the same tool calls.

exempt_tools.description: Tools whose repeated identical calls are expected, such as waits.

threshold.description:
Consecutive identical calls (or repeated call cycles) that trigger a reminder.
Twice this many stops the turn. Must be between 2 and 100 while enabled.

OutputContractSettings.description: Hold a subagent to the output schema its caller requested.

max_retries.description: Corrective reminders before a non-conforming result is returned as invalid.

oneOf.description: Claude Pro/Max through the Claude Code binary (`anthropicSubscriptionProvider`).

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in for the host `claude` login (ambient lane).

behavior.description: Coordinator-side guards that keep agents working, out of loops, and informed.

sessionDir.description: Empty selects `<data>/sessions/<canonical-project-key>`; relative overrides use the workspace directory.

session_dir.description: Empty selects `<data>/sessions/<canonical-project-key>`; relative overrides use the workspace directory.

StreamGuardSettings.description: Stop a streamed response that degenerates into repetition and retry with a correction.

max_retries.description: Corrected retries per turn before the turn fails.

TodoContinuationSettings.description: Remind an agent that ends its turn while its todo list still has open items.

max_reminders.description: Reminders per turn; a reminder is only repeated after the agent made tool calls.
